root_cause.text: The `__sctp_rcv_asconf_lookup()` function in `net/sctp/input.c` fails to validate that the address parameter's declared length fits within the received ASCONF chunk boundary before accessing it, allowing `from_addr_param()` to read uninitialized memory from truncated packets.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the function "only checks that the ASCONF chunk can hold the ADDIP header and a parameter header" before calling `from_addr_param()` which "reads the full address ... trusting the parameter's declared length," while the patch adds the check `if (sizeof(*asconf) + ntohs(param->p.length) > ntohs(ch->length))` to verify the parameter lies within the chunk.
